newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIAN LEV FALLS TO 223-225 PER DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIAN LEV FALLS TO 223-225 PER DOLLAR.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev fell to 223-225 to the dollar around 1130 local time (0830 GMT) from 216-219 in early trade as foreign currency demand picked up again but supply remained low, traders said.

"More customers have placed (foreign currency) purchase orders since midmorning, pressuring the lev to 223 and even 225 in sporadic deals but supply is rather low even at the higher dollar/lev exchange rates," a bank dealer said.
Active dollar demand was seen at 225 levs per dollar, the dealer added.
The lev has consolidated between 218-220 per dollar around 1030 local time (0730 GMT) after opening at 216-219 as initial foreign currency demand has begun to subside, traders said.
The central bank (BNB) was not seen supporting the lev in the market so far today, dealers said. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
